applies_why: The judge text resolves a clash on Matthew 1:20 between the challenger's DR3 chain and the defender's CR2/CR3 chains, so K-C's chain-vs-chain requirement governs.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse -- read either as requiring assessment of the whole chains' support or as allowing an unresolved single-verse ambiguity to make the clash underdetermined.
why: The judge calls the clash underdetermined by contrasting a covenant-presence reading with a physical-source reading of Matthew 1:20 without weighing the parties' whole chains by footing, so it fails K-C's required chain-against-chain analysis.
